summary_responses.response: The article introduces DiffTry (Differential Retries), a lightweight, stateless mechanism that assigns different retry limits to different request priority classes to prioritize high-value transactions during microservice overloads. Simulation and a live Kubernetes deployment validate the model, showing DiffTry works as a drop-in service-mesh plugin and substantially reduces rejection of high-priority traffic under incidental and adversarial overload.
